recent_excerpts: Kaspersky ICS CERT reports 19.6% of ICS computers blocked malware in Q1 2026, the lowest rate since Q2 2023.
AI agents now discover and exploit obscure vulnerabilities autonomously, while AI-generated code floods pipelines with flaws. Defenders must adapt to agent-scale threats.
Rapid7 VP Christiaan Beek warns attackers are exploiting weak credentials and known flaws faster than defenders can patch — pace, not technique, is the 2026 differentiator.
